note: Planted-defect regression suite. Each entry names one writing failure mode, the fixture that carries it, and the check that must catch it. `python3 src/reproduce.py` runs the auditor over examples/fixtures/draft_defective.md with the defective ledgers and fails if any of these (rule, code) pairs is missing; it also fails if the clean draft raises any error or warning at all. The pair is the contract, not the message text.
